nom: FARMACY Bright On Daily AHA Foam Exfoliator

segments.oily: A reviewer with oily skin reports the foam removes excess oil and reduces congestion without leaving her face tight or dry, while another with oily acne-prone skin wanted a stronger option than this one.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin, including one with 'really rough dry skin,' report the foam cleans and mildly exfoliates without drying them out further, though one reviewer with dry skin found it dried her skin and increased redness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one with stubborn dry patches on the forehead and nose, report smoother, more even skin without stripping, though one limits use to twice a week in winter to avoid dryness.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe sensitive or reactive skin report no tightness, dryness or irritation and call it gentle enough for regular use; one reviewer found the scent a bit strong for sensitive skin, and another had a few bumps in the first days that resolved.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal, slightly dry-in-winter skin reports no change in dryness or oiliness after use, a neutral result.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the foam cleans without leaving skin tight or stripped, several noting it stays gentle even with daily use; a few dissent, including one whose skin dried out and required extra moisturizer, and others who limit use to a few times a week to avoid over-drying in winter.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation; one reviewer's skin dried out enough that she needed more moisturizer to keep redness down, while another reports the foam calmed her redness over two weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some who describe themselves as acne-prone, report no new breakouts and some note fewer clogged pores or smaller bumps around the chin; one reviewer had a few small breakouts appear after weeks of use, her first in years.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe the foam as cleansing and mildly exfoliating without disturbing the skin's moisture barrier, crediting ingredients like panthenol; no reviewer reports barrier damage from the product itself.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports less visible dark spots alongside softer, more even skin after two weeks of use; this is the only mention of pigmentation in the set.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the foam removes excess oil and reduces congestion without leaving her face tight or dry; no other reviewer in this set raises an oiliness concern.

aspects.libelle: Chemical undertone in scent bothers some
Quick 30-second treatment, easy to add to routine
Pump can work poorly in the shower
Good-sized bottle, lasts a long time

extraits.titre: Not for me but wish it was!
extraits.texte: I've used this product in the shower once a week over the last few weeks. While I was really optimistic, my skin can't handle it :-( it dries out my skin and I find that I need to moisturize even more than usual to keep the redness down. I started out using it every other day then moved to once a week to try to see if I could make it work. Sadly couldn't but it does smell so good!!!

I've been using it a few times a week for several weeks. My skin is softer, more hydrated and brighter. It feels great on the skin. I use it after a nightly shower followed my a nighttime moisturizer. However, I also have had small breakouts which I haven't had in years. I will continue to use to see if the breakouts continue

I have used this product daily since receiving it, and i really do enjoy it! I have really rough dry skin, and I definitely could see a difference in my skin! I also have sensitive skin and did not have any issues. It did not leave any residue on my skin afterwards. "Farmacy sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program."

extraits.titre: it's a great option for oily skin
extraits.texte: As someone with oily skin, I found the Farmacy Bright On Daily Foam Exfoliator to be a gentle yet effective cleanser that doesn't strip my skin. The light foaming texture feels fresh and helps remove excess oil without leaving my face tight or dry. After regular use, my skin looks clearer and smoother, especially around areas prone to congestion. It exfoliates mildly enough for daily use while still giving a noticeable brightening effect.

I have combo skin with very stubborn dry patches on my forehead and around my nose, and this has been such a pleasant surprise. After just one week of daily use, my skin feels incredibly soft, smooth, and more even. It gently exfoliates without irritating or drying out my skin, and I love that it doesn't leave that tight, stripped feeling some exfoliators do. My dry patches look noticeably improved and my skin feels balanced and refreshed after every use. I've officially added this to my daily routine and would absolutely recommend it to anyone with combo skin or persistent dry texture looking for a gentle but effective exfoliant.

Thank you BzzAgent for sending me this product in exchange for an honest review!! I've been using this product three times a week since I received it and I can absolutely see a difference in the brightness and feel how much softer in my skin is. I have sensitive skin that reacts easily so I don't Much and I have to be very careful with the products that I use. this is extremely gentle and does not irritate my skin at all, also doesn't have any pretty fine particulates that you have to scrub into your face. I love that it's a foam and it's easy to dispense, and I don't have to leave it on my face for a long time, it's super easy to use. I love this brand's commitment to use and clean ingredients. I'm absolutely going to be trying other products in addition to re-purchasing this.

It smelled amazing! It might be overwhelming for some but I loved the smell. My skin feels and looks really good after just a couple weeks of use. It can be a little drying so I don't use it everyday but it is definitely part of my skincare routine. I like the foam pump as well. Even though I have been using it for a little over 2 weeks now, I could skin feeling softer and looking more even with less dark spots and a slight glow.
